title: Prospective cell-type-resolved and dose-controlled healthy-PBMC recombinant IFN-beta validation (Successor to BN-PB-IV-004)

BN-PB-IV-003_C03.reason: GSE224351 lacks explicit baseline-to-6h participant mapping and is below locked threshold

BN-PB-IV-004.reason: Unseparated whole-PBMC prospective cohort failed minimum 0.65 concordance threshold (observed 0.5532)

scientific_rationale.mechanism_hypothesis: C04 whole-PBMC aggregate exhibited non-concordance (55.3%) due to cell-type composition variation across resting vs activated lymphocytes. BN-PB-IV-005 tests cell-type resolved subsets (CD14+ Monocytes, CD4+ T Cells) alongside unseparated PBMC under standardized high-potency recombinant human IFN-beta-1a (1000 IU/mL, 6h).
prohibited_actions: re-running BN-PB-IV-004 with different random seeds or subsetting
claiming biological validation from historical failed cohorts

claim_boundary.target: donor-aware directional reproducibility of the frozen IFN-beta pseudobulk signature in cell-type resolved and dose-controlled prospective PBMC holdout
not_target: cell-type identity assignment without orthogonal markers

analysis_population.material: fresh healthy adult PBMC isolated within 2h of phlebotomy
analysis_population.donor_context: healthy adult volunteers independent of GSE96583, Parse-10M, and BN-PB-IV-004

cohorts.source: prospective fresh PBMC multi-arm trial at certified GLP core facility
cohorts.vehicle_control: matched carrier PBS + 0.1% human serum albumin
cohorts.paired_design: split-donor before incubation into opaque ARM_A and ARM_B

identity_and_pairing_contract.authoritative_key: participant_id_hash exported from source LIMS/consent registry before sequencing
identity_and_pairing_contract.pair_definition: two aliquots share exact authoritative participant_id_hash with distinct opaque arm IDs
identity_and_pairing_contract.missing_or_ambiguous_key_action: ABSTAIN; do not infer or repair a pair

experimental_randomization_and_blinding.aliquot_assignment: computer-randomized within donor to opaque ARM_A or ARM_B before stimulation
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.condition_key_repository_policy: completed key held outside repository until independent review is complete
experimental_randomization_and_blinding.analysis_labels: opaque cohort, participant, aliquot, library, and arm identifiers

donor_leave_one_out.role: carried frozen from predecessor; no refitting

platform_holdout.role: C02 Parse platform context retained; not refitted

matched_6h_holdout.metric: median paired-donor direction concordance for the frozen C01 top-100 genes in C05 cell-type resolved subsets

multi_cohort.metric: fraction of frozen signature genes with consistent direction in C01, complete C02, and C05

negative_control.identity_assignment_handling: observed assignment excluded from null and included once by plus-one numerator_and_denominator

decision_policy.failed_endpoint: retain result and set status to negative_result
